sentences.text:
Petitioners apprehend their arrest in a case Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.49721 of 2022(6)
dt.21-07-2023 registered for the offence punishable under Section 420, 467. 468/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
4. As per the prosecution case, these petitioners committed defalcation of Rs. 60,000,00/- by showing forged purchase of milk.
5. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that petitioners are innocent and have falsely been implicated in the case.

It is further submitted that from bare perusal of the FIR it is apparent that so called embezzlement of money is of the year 2014 but the FIR has been lodged in the year 2019 after inordinate delay of more than four years without any explanation.

It is next submitted that allegation against the petitioner is that they defalcated an amount of Rs. 60 lacs but in the FIR itself it is stated that petitioners got Rs. 41,01,154/- during the working days 15 months and five days of the said committee.

The petitioners have registers regarding sale and purchase of milk from the farmers and payment of money and allegation leveled against them that they did not provide the registers before the enquiry committee is false.
6. Learned counsel appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.49721 of 2022(6) dt.21-07-2023 7.

Considering the facts of the case and nature of accusation against the petitioners, let the petitioners, above named, in the event of their arrest/ surrender within a period of six weeks from today shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bhojpur, Ara in connection with Agiaon Bazar PS case No. 71/ 2019,

subject to conditions laid down u/s 438(2) of the Cr. P. C. (Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) BKS/-
